integrity: Proof is analytic and self-contained; volume is normalized exactly; no numerical experiment is used as proof. A direct arXiv HTML fetch was unavailable during this check, so the source is motivation only and its uninspected proof is not relied on.
scientific_limitations: The claim is a static construction in Euclidean space, not a flow-existence or flow-singularity statement.
The construction does not impose constant mean curvature, convexity, or second-order curvature pinching.
The local constants depend on fixed dimension, chart, cutoff, and radius, not on the oscillation frequency.
title: Arbitrarily large curvature under vanishing radial and normal-angle deviations
